name: goose
what: An open-source, general-purpose AI agent that runs on your machine as a desktop app (macOS, Linux, Windows), a CLI and an API. It isn't only for code: it also handles research, writing and automation. It supports 15+ model providers and connects to tools through MCP extensions. Originally from Block, now part of the Agentic AI Foundation. Apache-2.0.
who: People who want one local agent for coding and everyday tasks, with their choice of model.

setup.text: Download the desktop app from goose-docs.ai/docs/getting-started/installation, or install the CLI:
Run goose configure to pick a provider and model, then start a session:
Add MCP extensions from the desktop app or through goose configure.
